context.narrative_job: Join the complete accepted EP007 picture into one uninterrupted review while preserving every scoped scene lock and the established audio corrections.
context.viewer_before: All scene-level gates are closed, but the accepted pieces have not been watched as one episode.
context.viewer_after: The owner can review the complete 18:55.041667 episode as one continuous candidate and decide whether the whole episode is ready to lock.

data.choice: Build R79 as a direct-cut 24 fps 1280x720 review conform from the R77 frame map, replacing its pending S15 and S16 baselines with the exact owner-locked R78 scene renders. For S17, use frames [192,1803) of the exact owner-reviewed R76 context render as one continuous 1,611-frame source, rather than recreating the accepted P1-to-C and C-to-P2 seams from three separately encoded files. Retain the R58 decoded audio prefix and append the locked narration-master tail according to the audited sample map. Add no transitions, retiming, grade, music, SFX, captions or picture redesign.
data.reason: The R76 context is the strongest available carrier for the accepted S17 assembly because the owner reviewed its complete P1-presenter-P2 continuity. Trimming only its 192-frame S16 lead-in preserves those exact rendered seams and reduces conform risk without changing timing or content.

alternatives.choice: Assemble S17 P1, C and P2 from three separately encoded sources
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The frame math is valid, but rebuilding two joins is weaker than reusing the exact accepted context encode that already contains them.

alternatives.choice: Rebuild the entire episode as one new HyperFrames composition
alternatives.reason_not_selected: A new renderer pass would recreate already accepted picture and introduce unnecessary drift risk when the current task is exact conform.

alternatives.choice: Concatenate each scene's encoded audio with its picture
alternatives.reason_not_selected: That would reintroduce AAC seams and could undo the accepted R58 level repairs; the audited continuous-audio plan is authoritative.

reuse.applies_when: Assembling the current owner-locked EP007 scene package for uninterrupted review.
reuse.avoid_when: A source hash, frame interval, scene duration, narration sample map or owner lock changes.

cut_cues.relation: Direct cuts at the exact half-open output-frame intervals in the updated R79 segment map; S17 is one continuous accepted source over output frames [17807,19418).

cut_cues.protected_hold: Preserve every accepted scene ending, S25's intentional pause, S26's complete final card and the 1481-sample EOF pad.
